Evidence: https://www.rtx.com/who-we-are Raytheon is an RTX business: https://www.rtx.com/news/news-center/2026/10/09/r2s-delivers-first-us-produced-tamir-interceptors

records.name: TikTok
records.reason: TikTok reported nearly 7,000 US employees in 2023; its US data-security subsidiary reported more than 2,000 US-based staff in 2025. Evidence: https://newsroom.tiktok.com/150-m-us-users?lang=en ; https://newsroom.tiktok.com/facts-matter-how-tiktok-protects-us-user-data?lang=en
